second_pass.method: 首轮逐段检查外层表达骨架和内部搭配，二遍回看全部未收段及已收段中的对比、让步、否定、责任和请求动作；只在总统素材内查重，未按组成词简单推定掌握。
second_pass.intentionally_omitted: 称呼名单、套式宗教祝福、专名和政治口号、一次性长比喻；单词义项不伪装固定词块。

items.note: 属于制度论述搭配，不声称日常高频。
items.quote: The peaceful transfer of authority is rare in history, yet common in our country.

items.note: 原句竞选结束时保持风度，不是舞蹈优雅。
items.quote: As I begin, I thank President Clinton for his service to our Nation, and I thank Vice President Gore for a contest conducted with spirit and ended with grace.

items.chunk: be honored and humbled to do sth.
items.meaning: 能做某事感到荣幸与谦卑
items.note: 适合承接重任或荣誉，非受羞辱。
items.quote: I am honored and humbled to stand here where so many of America's leaders have come before me, and so many will follow.

items.note: 可用于普通人或新方案，不仅政治立场。
items.quote: The grandest of these ideals is an unfolding American promise that everyone belongs, that everyone deserves a chance, that no insignificant person was ever born.

items.meaning: 被赋予做某事的使命或责任
items.note: 此处非打电话叫来，而是道德责任。
items.quote: Americans are called to enact this promise in our lives and in our laws.

items.note: 原句信念在各国扎根。
items.quote: Now it is a seed upon the wind, taking root in many nations.

items.meaning: 将某物传下去／转交下去
items.note: 原句 a trust；不单指消息转发。
items.quote: It is the inborn hope of our humanity, an ideal we carry but do not own, a trust we bear and pass along.

items.chunk: have a long way yet to travel
items.note: 原句社会理想仍未完成，是旅程比喻。
items.quote: Even after nearly 225 years, we have a long way yet to travel.

items.note: 原句 differences；可接 feelings、divisions 等。
items.quote: And sometimes our differences run so deep, it seems we share a continent but not a country.

items.note: 原句省略 that，不将语气判断当证实事实。
items.quote: And sometimes our differences run so deep, it seems we share a continent but not a country.

items.chunk: While 从句, others 从句
items.note: while 在此对比不同群体，非单纯同时。
items.quote: While many of our citizens prosper, others doubt the promise, even the justice of our own country.

items.meaning: 在某人能力所及范围内
items.note: 原句集体目标可实现；不是正在手里握着。
items.quote: I know this is in our reach because we are guided by a power larger than ourselves, who creates us equal, in His image, and we are confident in principles that unite and lead us onward.

items.meaning: 使某人超越某种局限／利益
items.note: 原句 lift us above our interests；不是所有提升都用above。
items.quote: We are bound by ideals that move us beyond our backgrounds, lift us above our interests, and teach us what it means to be citizens.

items.meaning: 处在最佳状态；表现最好时
items.note: at its best 与正常总体评价不同。
items.quote: America at its best matches a commitment to principle with a concern for civility.

items.meaning: 将理想／信念落实到生活中
items.note: 原句 promise；不是 live out one's days 的度余生义。
items.quote: Today we affirm a new commitment to live out our Nation's promise through civility, courage, compassion, and character.

items.note: good will 与 goodwill 同概念；原拼法保留。
items.quote: A civil society demands from each of us good will and respect, fair dealing and forgiveness.

items.note: 不只买卖价格公平。
items.quote: A civil society demands from each of us good will and respect, fair dealing and forgiveness.

items.meaning: 某事所牵涉的得失和风险
items.note: 非木桩或赌注字面；可谈争论的重要性。
items.quote: Some seem to believe that our politics can afford to be petty because in a time of peace the stakes of our debates appear small.

items.chunk: If sb. does not do sth., ...
items.note: 本段三次表达不行动的后果，不据普通语法判已掌握。
items.quote: If our country does not lead the cause of freedom, it will not be led.

items.meaning: 达到某个标准／不辜负某种要求
items.note: 原句 calling；与总统候选其他篇同义者合并为例证。
items.quote: We must live up to the calling we share.

items.note: 原句 this commitment, if we keep it，it 回指承诺。
items.quote: And this commitment, if we keep it, is a way to shared accomplishment.

items.note: 此处把问题甩给后代，与传承理念有负面区别。
items.quote: We must show courage in a time of blessing by confronting problems instead of passing them on to future generations.

items.meaning: 让某人免于某种痛苦或困难
items.note: 原句 struggles；不同于给某人腾出时间。
items.quote: We will reform Social Security and Medicare, sparing our children from struggles we have the power to prevent.

items.note: 非物理动量。
items.quote: And we will reduce taxes to recover the momentum of our economy and reward the effort and enterprise of working Americans.

items.meaning: 务必明白；不要误以为别的意思
items.note: 原句主语 enemies should，语气强势。
items.quote: The enemies of liberty and our country should make no mistake: America remains engaged in the world, by history and by choice, shaping a balance of power that favors freedom.

items.note: 与原句 by history 对照，非偶然。
items.quote: The enemies of liberty and our country should make no mistake: America remains engaged in the world, by history and by choice, shaping a balance of power that favors freedom.

items.meaning: 不诚实的意图；缺乏诚意
items.note: 与宗教信仰不同。
items.quote: We will meet aggression and bad faith with resolve and strength.

items.meaning: 为某种价值发声／代表它
items.note: 此处不是 speak for sb. 代某人决定的接法。
items.quote: And to all nations, we will speak for the values that gave our Nation birth.

items.meaning: 无论某人对某事有什么看法
items.note: 原句省略 may be；用来先承认立场差异。
items.quote: And whatever our views of its cause, we can agree that children at risk are not at fault.

items.meaning: 处于危险／容易受害的状态
items.note: 原句 children；风险具体内容需语境。
items.quote: And whatever our views of its cause, we can agree that children at risk are not at fault.

items.note: 原句否定，强调孩子无需为贫困负责。
items.quote: And whatever our views of its cause, we can agree that children at risk are not at fault.

items.note: 原句反对用天灾解释遗弃和虐待；并非通常上帝的一切行为。
items.quote: Abandonment and abuse are not acts of God; they are failures of love.

items.note: 通常说明某种手段无法弥补另一种必要条件。
items.quote: And the proliferation of prisons, however necessary, is no substitute for hope and order in our souls.

items.note: 原句贫困者，非随意需要一个物品。
items.quote: Americans in need are not strangers; they are citizens-- not problems but priorities.

items.note: 原句 however necessary 为省略结构；仍承认必要性。
items.quote: And the proliferation of prisons, however necessary, is no substitute for hope and order in our souls.

items.meaning: 对某事起反应／能因某事而缓解
items.note: 原句人的深刻创伤会因导师关怀而缓解，非回复邮件义。
items.quote: And some needs and hurts are so deep they will only respond to a mentor's touch or a pastor's prayer.

items.meaning: 使某人获得自由／摆脱束缚
items.note: 原句承诺使人自由为比喻，非真开牢门。
items.quote: And we find that children and community are the commitments that set us free.

items.note: 此处道德行为引导自由的使用。
items.quote: Our public interest depends on private character, on civic duty and family bonds and basic fairness, on uncounted, unhonored acts of decency, which give direction to our freedom.

items.note: 非服务某个客户个人。
items.quote: I will live and lead by these principles: to advance my convictions with civility, to serve the public interest with courage, to speak for greater justice and compassion, to call for responsibility and try to live it, as well.

items.chunk: I ask sb. to do sth.
items.note: 演讲语气直接，不代表所有工作场景礼貌程度相同。
items.quote: I ask you to seek a common good beyond your comfort, to defend needed reforms against easy attacks, to serve your Nation, beginning with your neighbor.

items.note: 原句 anything Government does 是强调比较标准。
items.quote: What you do is as important as anything Government does.

items.chunk: not because 从句 but because 从句
items.note: 与Obama2013同功能骨架，待全总统范围合并。
items.quote: Americans are generous and strong and decent, not because we believe in ourselves but because we hold beliefs beyond ourselves.

items.chunk: Do you not think 从句?
items.note: 历史引文引导认同；比 Don't you think 庄重，不能当无偏询问。
items.quote: Do you not think an angel rides in the whirlwind and directs this storm?''

items.chunk: Much time has passed since 从句
items.note: 保留时间起点，非所有 since 都因果。
items.quote: Much time has passed since Jefferson arrived for his inauguration.

items.meaning: 为某人服务；服务于某人
items.note: 原句 to one another，非 in service 设备运行状态。
items.quote: And our duty is fulfilled in service to one another.

duplicates_skipped.quote: Sometimes in life we're called to do great things.

quote_recovery: 已确认候选的原例收为目标所在完整原句或必要连续片段；只回收原文子串，没有发现新项或改写。原精选精确引文保留。
